cases.scenario: A Finder submits nine specifications; eight are approved and one requires revision, then is approved on decision two.
expected: Only the disputed specification returns to the Finder.
All nine approved specifications are handed to one area Fixer as a batch after the candidate ledger reaches terminal specification states.

cases.scenario: One of nine specifications is still unapproved after its third Spec Verifier decision.
expected: The other eight approved specifications may proceed unless they depend on the unresolved specification.
The unresolved specification remains disclosed and is not represented as fixed.

cases.scenario: The fresh Fix Verifier reproduces a regression after the Fixer completes an area batch.
expected: The finding returns to the Fixer for evidence-backed repair.
The fresh Fix Verifier re-audits the complete updated area.

cases.scenario: SUSTAINED(10) has ten useful active subagents and twelve compatible runnable tasks; one subagent completes.
expected: The completed task stops counting as active.
The Main Agent launches the next highest-priority compatible runnable task in the same orchestration turn.
Useful active concurrency returns to ten without exceeding ten.

cases.scenario: SUSTAINED(10) has only three useful dependency-ready non-conflicting tasks.
expected: Record CONCURRENCY_UNDERFILLED with the ready-work reason.
Do not create placeholder agents, duplicate investigations, or conflicting writers.

cases.scenario: A Finder completes the frozen area search frontier with no reproducible candidate.
expected: Zero findings is accepted without a quota.
The area may become AREA_NO_VERIFIED_BUGS with its coverage evidence.
The campaign does not claim the system is universally bug-free.
